issues.decision: APPROVED scoped correction, assertions and preserved native regression evidence
issues.root_cause_correction: Exclude and verify the retained legacy directory before list migration isolation and before any direct current/legacy read. Initial exclusion failure propagates as a safe I/O error instead of empty inventory; malformed/oversized last-copy data remains available for Retry/Discard.
fresh_path_review: iOS PlatformStorage binding -> singleton FileBackedSnapshotStore -> list/read -> exclusion before migration; direct reads cannot bypass it.
Fresh NSURL resource readback checks boolValue after setting the flag. Retry re-applies exclusion instead of trusting lazy/cached success; explicit discard does not retry a failing excluder.
Bounded reads, current-protected precedence, authenticated write-before-delete, safe error mapping and CancellationException propagation are unchanged. No snapshots or secrets are sent to peers.
issues.regression_evidence: 8 IosLegacySnapshotBackupTest +6 IosStorageSafetyTest actual native methods in combined-native-alltests-02. Current implementation/test and related store bytes match both execution manifests. Tests inspect actual Foundation flags and preserved synthetic bytes, including direct-read, malformed-current, oversize, exclusion failure, retry/recreation and explicit discard.
counter_evidence: Existing recognized-PARSNAP invalid-version/key-loss finally branch still deletes stale legacy bytes; original finding explicitly distinguished that already-handled path. Do not claim legacy copies are never deleted.
Backup-exclusion request/readback is OS guidance, not actual physical backup/restore or historical-backup removal. IOS-R1 is a separate evidence gap.
issues.compatibility: No crypto, key, snapshot-envelope or serialized-format change.
issues.remaining: Physical backup/lock/keychain and any separate signed/native persistence gates cannot be inferred from these filesystem tests.

fresh_path_review: Actual SettingsScreen -> SettingsMutationDispatcher -> PersistentSettingsStore -> App -> ProvideAppLanguage path was reopened. Nullable System remains null; no language-keyed navigation/session recreation.

Owner records exact previous persistent application-domain array versus absence, prepares its own marker before installing and releases only valid metadata with exact current-installed-array equality. Resolved global fallback is not promoted into the app domain.

Different external OS preference wins; identical unowned preference is not claimed or removed. Malformed prior ownership record cannot install an invalid previous array. Marked interrupted lifetimes reconcile on restart/System.

One remembered provider owner and one stable Swift outer/Compose child remain. Full physical child bounds, normal containment and appearance/decoration/orientation forwarding were inspected. Native semantic refresh is conditional on actual direction change/window attachment for pinned Compose1.10.3.
issues.regression_evidence: 11 native ownership methods;14 current structural contracts;2 Mafia +2 Whodunit actual Desktop host-continuity methods rebound to current affected source. Native04 executes4 production UIKit container tests +1 actual Settings/local-session/OS matrix, accepted independently by /root/factory_review. issues.decision: APPROVED scoped lifecycle identity correction and actual concurrency/composable regressions
issues.root_cause_correction: Reserve lifecycle IDs atomically outside queue insertion and key effects by state owner plus ID. Never derive new lifetime identity from only currently queued items.
fresh_path_review: Atomic Long updateAndGet transform is pure; queue CAS may retry without reserving another identity. Overflow fails closed instead of wrapping. IDs do not represent queue insertion order.
Distinct lifetime IDs and key(state,toast.id) reset remembered visibility/expiry after a conflated empty frame or replacement owner. Old expiry cannot dismiss a fresh never-reused ID.
Four-entry queue bound and adjacent-text coalescing stay intact. Public asynchronous error/outcome callers remain; no persistent state or extra retained scope was added.
issues.regression_evidence: 4 common state methods x4 actual tasks (Desktop,iOS,Android debug-unit,release-unit)=16 executions;2 concurrency +3 actual Compose timer methods. Replacement tests wait for production auto-dismiss, enqueue only via public show, assert new visibility and later independent expiry. Current source/test hashes match before/after manifests.
counter_evidence: Ordinary notifications separated by a composed empty frame worked before; tests intentionally force the legal conflation schedule.
Android unit executions are JVM, not Android UI. Finite concurrency tests are not exhaustive; Long.MAX_VALUE exhaustion is source-reviewed, not run to exhaustion.
issues.compatibility: Presentation-only lifetime identifiers; no serializer/protocol/session change.
issues.remaining: Mobile runtime timing and device accessibility are not proved by Desktop composable tests.
